fact_verification: verified 2026-10-22 via web research: CVE-2026-109618 (OOM corruption) + CVE-2026-109619 (stale global state), both CVSS v4.0 9.2, pre-auth RCE reached while PHP parses the request before app code; fixed 2026-10-21 in 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12, no official release for 8.1 and below; discovered with AI assistance, independently by Wiz; PHP on ~70% of the web; Amazon attempt logged ~Oct 17 pre-patch; Cloudflare counting millions of attempts; exploit tooling public; no confirmed breach; CISA not KEV-listed as of 10-23; public exploit fails on stock install. Live version keeps the hedging. Addendum 2026-10-23: NSA advisory 'Critical PHP Patching Released' (nsa.gov press release, read in full) confirms: nickname PHP2Shell; unauthenticated takeover of affected web servers; flaws in PHP core, not the hosted application or its configuration; servers running affected versions described as exploitable; patch released Wed 2026-10-21; NSA instructs immediate inventory of services on vulnerable PHP, enhanced logging, replacement of end-of-life PHP that will not take the patch, and taking systems offline if immediate update is not feasible; co-signed CISA / NCSC UK / ASD ACSC / CERT-EU. Advisory asserts exploitability and likely weaponization but reports no confirmed compromise.
